request_type: Event: J70 Corinthian World Championship Race Number: 02
procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Thomas Loesch.
FRA 1412 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The technical committee provided photographic evidence of the incident.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: FRA 1412 was towed out of the harbour at 10:31 on 27 May 2026.
The first race on 27 May 2026 (race 2) was scheduled to start at 11:05, but started at 14:25.
conclusions: By being towed, FRA 1412 received outside assistance after leaving its dock, and broke Class Rule I.3.
None of the exceptions provided for in Class Rule I.3 applied.
As the race start was postponed, FRA 1412 did not obtain a competitive advantage.
Under SI 14.8, the penalty for this breach shall not be less than a ten percent (10%) scoring penalty.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons, a starting penalty of 5% was decided. There were no facts to justify decreasing or increasing the penalty. However, the penalty is increased to 10% in accordance with SI 14.8. The penalty given to FRA 1412 is a 10% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in RRS 44.3(c) and applied to race 2, but not worse than the score for DNF.
